styleAndCtaDirectives: Open the first paragraph immediately with concrete dollar stakes ($X,XXX–$XX,XXX) and the exact state statutory form or inspection section—avoid slow travel-brochure city introductions (which showed 0%–14% engagement in GA4 on Orange and El Paso prior to rewrite).

Include 3 to 4 direct question-matching FAQ items answering exact conversational queries discovered in GSC (e.g. 'Can termites damage my house structure in one year?', 'What is a termite letter and who pays for it?', 'Why do homes in [City] have [Defect]?').

Tailor the mid-article HTML callout heading specifically to the exact document or defect discussed in the article (e.g., 'Reviewing a [State] Seller Disclosure or WDI Report?') rather than generic copy to maximize blog_cta_click conversions.
